title: Sablewood™ Logistics Preserve
kicker: An ancient forest logistics preserve where colossal trees, hybrid fauna, underroot communities, route tolls, and corporate liability...
hook: An ancient forest logistics preserve where colossal trees, hybrid fauna, underroot communities, route tolls, and corporate liability language all compete to define what safety means.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: Sablewood is an ancient forest forced to wear a logistics badge: colossal trunks, liability signs, toll language, and living routes that do not care about forms.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: The trees go up until the sky closes over, and the light that reaches the road is green and always moving. A vest-badge nailed to a trunk reads Sablewood Logistics Preserve, and a hundred yards on the same kind of trunk has swallowed an older sign whole...

blocks.label: What Is Here
blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place Cat-Squirrels leap limb to limb and knock dew from leaves Giraffe-Deer step over the road as if wagons are very short problems Lemur-Toads gossip-click from rain hollows and go silent when large predators...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Trade here moves in waxed parcels and field rations, hard bread, smoked strips, larkmoth honey scraped out of orchid hollows. A toll-post sells the same dried fruit it confiscated that morning. Lemur-toads watch you...

affordances: Look for the busiest local gathering point.
Ask what has changed here recently.
